claim: Barack Obama called the Trump administration probe of Ilhan Omar appalling, saying agents sought a nonexistent smoking gun from 20 years ago
read: The claim does not match the cited record. NYT, citing current and former officials, reports an Obama-era FBI and DHS probe in 2016 found some evidence the 2009 marriage was fraudulent; it stalled on the five-year statute of limitations. Obama’s characterization of a nonexistent smoking gun and a purely ancient inquiry omits that contemporaneous record.

sources.title: New York Times — Ilhan Omar Investigation Involves New Scrutiny of Long-Disputed Marriage
Barack Obama statement via X, as reported

script:
Good morning. This is Morning Check.

Former President Barack Obama called the current federal investigation into Representative Ilhan Omar appalling. He said agents raided her home to uncover a nonexistent smoking gun from 20 years ago, the full weight of government aimed at a critic.

The New York Times reported yesterday, citing current and former officials, that the FBI and Department of Homeland Security investigated Omar’s 2009 marriage to Ahmed Nur Said Elmi in the summer of 2016—under the Obama administration. Those officials said investigators found some evidence the marriage was fraudulent. The potential felony fell outside the five-year statute of limitations, so the case stalled. No charges followed.

Obama’s statement treats the inquiry as nonexistent and ancient. The public record, as reported by the Times, shows an investigation under his own administration that turned up some evidence of possible fraud, limited only by the clock. That context is missing from the claim.

The claim does not match the cited record. Omar has denied the allegations; no charges have been filed. This is the record as it stands.

Independent commentary. Not affiliated with any broadcaster.
